commit.message: [nr-k8s-otel-collector] Routing based on metric not datapoint (#1857) #### Is this a new chart NO. #### What this PR does / why we need it: Routing for the otel collector was using data point. The issue here is that it seems that only the data points were being routed to the down stream pipelines. This means that the rest of the metric's metadata was being chopped off. This is _mostly_ not an issue because the data point has access to the scope/resource anyway. Thee's honestly not a ton of data attached to the metric context itself. Metrics don't even have their own attributes. However there are two specific fields that are important for SUMs aggregation_temporality is_monotonic By default we're only sending one sum kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total. Due to the missing attributes this sum was being rejected at the NR Otel Endpoint. There are a couple other SUMS that this agent will send if enabled. otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records otelcol_process_runtime_total_alloc_bytes And others. These were seeming to come through just fine surprisingly. However turns out the reason this was is because these metrics are reported from both the daemonset and the deployment. The daemonset uses the metric context for routing not datapoint. After fix kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total is being reported When enabled otelcol_process_runtime_total_alloc_bytes is being reported for both the deployment and daemonset. No events are being rejected from the NR otel metric endpoint. Before the fix... No kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total When enabled otelcol_process_runtime_total_alloc_bytes is being reported only from for both the daemonset. NR otel endpoint rejects This investigation was initiated in order to fix the kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total so I'm also updating the cumulativetodelta processor to exclude this metric as well. This metric should stay a cumulative sum instead of a delta. Metric count before/ after this change. We can see that we're getting 1 extra metric after the change (`kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total`) https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/tree/main/pkg/ottl/contexts/ottlmetric #### Which issue this PR fixes *(optional, in `fixes #(, fixes #, ...)` format, will close that issue when PR gets merged)* - fixes Issue dropping sums due to routing table using datapoints instead of metric. - kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total should be a cumulative sum not a delta sum #### Special notes for your reviewer: #### Checklist [Place an '[x]' (no spaces) in all applicable fields. Please remove unrelated fields.] - [x] Chart Version bumped - [x] Variables are documented in the README.md - [x] Title of the PR starts with chart name (e.g. `[mychartname]`) # Release Notes to Publish (nr-k8s-otel-collector) If this PR contains changes in `nr-k8s-otel-collector`, please complete the following section. All other charts should ignore this section. ## 🚀 What's Changed * Fixes Issue where sums were being dropped due to missing temporality data. * `kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total` is ignored by `cumulativetodelta` processor so it remains a cumulative metric.
